coverage.justification: Reviewed technical paths cover bounded scheduled network and timetable concepts.
coverage.limitations: Does not establish full Annex coverage, historical/observed data, NAP publication/access, or legal compliance.

coverage.justification: A bounded NeTEx relationship is identified, but applicable profile/category coverage cannot yet be resolved.
coverage.limitations: Applicable minimum profile and category scope remain unresolved; do not infer complete coverage or legal compliance.

coverage.justification: A reviewed deadline/procedural path is identified without manufacturing a technical mapping.
coverage.limitations: Calendar/feed date fields do not establish timely legal provision; dated NAP publication/access and applicable scope evidence remain necessary.

coverage.justification: Hybrid technical and external evidence paths cover bounded publisher/attribution and request-context aspects.
coverage.limitations: Publisher metadata and attribution do not establish all provenance, request/response, disclosure, or reuse facts; no legal compliance is asserted.

coverage.justification: A reviewed manual assessment path is identified without manufacturing a technical mapping.
coverage.limitations: Operational records, sampled declarations and corroboration are needed; the pilot does not define method, frequency, sample size, or legal compliance outcome.

coverage.justification: An institutional/legal-process evaluation path is identifiable, but no justified reusable technical capability mapping exists.
coverage.limitations: Assessment requires authoritative external evidence establishing the relevant National Access Point. Technical accessibility or dataset-format evidence alone does not prove this obligation. No legal-compliance conclusion is made.

coverage.justification: An organizational/institutional evaluation path concerning the access point role as the single point of access is identifiable; no justified reusable technical capability mapping exists.
coverage.limitations: Assessment requires authoritative organizational/designation evidence. Dataset presence or technical accessibility alone does not prove single-access-point status. No legal-compliance conclusion is made.

coverage.justification: A reviewed functional mapping for metadata-based dataset discovery coexists with the manual/external evaluation path.
coverage.limitations: Technical observation covers only some discovery behavior. Contextual and external evidence remains necessary for complete evaluation; this is not a legal-compliance conclusion.

coverage.justification: Evaluated B02 scope: ROAD_STATUS_DISRUPTION only. Persisted C01 category-specific partial mappings support a bounded part of the road dynamic-data requirement. PARTIAL is a semantic review, not a ratio of mappings. DATEX II RTTI RRP 2022/670 evidence; individual releases remain unresolved.
coverage.limitations: Not exhaustive; not observed implementation; not legal compliance conclusion. 5-SN-D deferred: profile/identity ambiguity. Frozen 2015/962 literal reference preserved; 2022/670 succession context is not a legal substitution. Other dynamic road-data scope and exact releases not established.

coverage.justification: Evaluated B02 scope: conditional Annex 2.1/2.2 concepts, with support limited to PASSENGER_RT_STATUS_DISRUPTION through C07 ET/SX. SIRI 2.1 / EPIP-RT CEN/TS 15531-7:2025. The accepted partial mappings support PARTIAL semantic coverage without establishing all concepts; no count-based percentage.
coverage.limitations: Not exhaustive; not observed implementation; not legal compliance conclusion. Gaps: C04 Article 5(2) road applicability; C08 normative FM/facility element path; CM guaranteed-connections bridge; U01 PARKING_TARIFF minimum general profile/version/elements and applicability; U02 SHARED_VEHICLE_AVAILABILITY modal profile/element evidence; U03 PARKING_AVAILABILITY on/off-street minimum profile and crosswalk. All deferred for closure; exact profile constraints and representability not established.
